verdict.rationale: Elastic's serverless docs claim automatic, usage-based scaling that spins resources up for spikes and back down without user action (elastic-docs-33, elastic-docs-26), implying smooth cost scaling, but no pricing/cost caps or predictable-billing model is documented. Community evidence directly contradicts the 'no surprise cliffs' claim: teams report Elastic's licensing/subscription fees 'eat up significant portions of the project's profits' and describe its pricing as expensive and nickel-and-diming compared to alternatives (elastic-comm-4, elastic-comm-5, elastic-comm-10, elastic-comm-12, elastic-comm-13). Missing for 10: any first-party pricing/cost-predictability documentation, cost caps, or independent case studies showing stable costs at scale.
